section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) used to measure body appreciation in the present study. The BAS-2 is a 10-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale, with higher scores indicating greater body appreciation. Internal consistency was strong (Cronbach's α = .95 for women, .93 for men), though no participant demographics, sample size, or correlations with BMI are provided in this section.
